Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You warm the bent hinge between your palms until the metal remembers the line it used to hold.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
One minute.
Target / range / shape
One accessible damaged component of an ordinary metal item, small enough to hold between your hands.
Type
Magic / Utility

Reshape a damaged fitting, fastener, edge or link that fits between your hands. Make a Knowledge roll.

Weak
Restore its ordinary function for the scene.
Standard
Restore its ordinary function permanently.
Strong
Also restore a second adjacent damaged component of the same item.
